svg.title: Pocket width
svg.desc: Two top views of the one-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults with hand size set to Custom, a 25 mm wide plug in teal. Right: pocket width at 34 mm. Marked in red: 1, the seat and the pocket: the round recess at the plug end; the plug recess on the centerline. 2, the zip-tie holes: the four small holes beside the pocket. 3, the wing openings: the two openings beside the pocket.
